pr-celebration-a.title: PR celebration, A - the number leads
pr-celebration-a.note: Owner-decisions round 2026-09-18 (plan task S3). A DESIGN ROUND on the PR celebration, not a production screen: the record itself is the hero - the tabular number at maximum size with one small unit beside it (rule 3), 'New personal record.' demoted to a kicker above it, the lift and the delta folded into one sentence on a 14 pt surface strip, and the monthly count as a gsSuccess tick on that strip rather than a bordered theme.surface chip at a third radius. Accent is spent once, on KEEP LIFTING; Share is a quiet raised face beneath it. Drawn over the same literal fixture as frame 29 (Bench Press, 205 x 5, prior 200, 3rd this month), so the owner compares compositions and not numbers. RETIRES at the owner's pick, together with pr-celebration-b and PRCelebrationVariations.swift; 151 is then a retired number and is never reused. Integration task I1 (2026-09-18, contingency path, constraint 7): LIVE — the owner's pick has not arrived at integration, so this id ships in this PR pending that pick; the retirement above becomes its own follow-up PR the moment the pick is recorded.

SessionLiveView(catalog: LiveFixtures.soloLive) - groupID/roomCode/scheduledFor all nil (SoloSessionShape.isSoloByConstruction's own triple) and participantCount 1, so hidesCrewFurniture is true: no rotation strip, no stations, no round wait, no waiting-on line, no talk dock.
